reason: While a no-spill tube would be great for my morning paratha tiffin, every packaged green chutney I've ever bought tasted horribly sour and synthetic.
objection: Packaged green chutney always tastes like chemicals and vinegar, never like fresh homemade dhaniya-pudina.
would_change_my_mind: A small trial pouch or sachet to taste verify that it lacks the artificial vinegar tang before committing ₹99.
